copy.tagline: 设计子问题的最佳回答顺序
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为复杂问题规划子问题的回答顺序
copy.tagline_en: Design the optimal answering order for sub-questions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to plan the order of sub-questions for complex queries

howto.what: Claude会分析你提供的子问题列表和依赖关系，设计出最优的回答顺序：哪些子问题可以同时做，哪些必须按顺序，并优先处理高风险项。
howto.when: 当你有一组需要回答的子问题，并已梳理出它们之间的依赖关系时，可以请求Claude规划执行顺序。

say.text: 帮我排一下这些子问题的回答顺序。
say.note: Claude会基于依赖图输出分阶段计划。

say.text: 哪些子问题可以并行回答？
say.note: Claude会识别出无依赖关系的子问题。

say.text: 请优先处理风险高的子问题。
say.note: Claude会调整顺序先解决高不确定性项。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes your sub-question list and dependency graph to design an optimal answering order: which sub-questions can be done in parallel, which must be sequential, and prioritizing high-risk items.
howto.when_en: When you have a set of sub-questions to answer and have identified their dependencies, you can ask Claude to plan the execution sequence.

say_en.text: Help me arrange the answering order for these sub-questions.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a phased plan based on the dependency graph.

say_en.text: Which sub-questions can be answered in parallel?
say_en.note: Claude identifies sub-questions with no mutual dependencies.
Claude adjusts the order to address high-uncertainty items first.
